detail.longDescription: ADM: Australian Internet Observatory launches pioneering national platform for digital research. “Australian researchers now have a new way to study the digital platforms shaping everyday life with the launch of a national self-service research infrastructure platform developed by the Australian Internet Observatory (AIO).” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/24/adm-australian-internet-observatory-launches-pioneering-national-platform-for-digital-research/
